REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this query asks for a source-grounded historical explanation, which combines evidence extraction from the provided sources with synthesis into a coherent paragraph. Willet has the edge on the relevant capability signals — higher Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 79.2) for pulling from the primary sources, plus stronger general knowledge/reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2) for accurate historical context. The task preferences don't favor either model here (the content is benign, and Lapwing's stated aversion to open-ended work is dissociated from actual capability anyway), so capability is the deciding factor and it points to Willet.
